_meta.note: All interface text. Components must not contain literal strings.

app.title: Bhumi Vikas Sahayak
app.subtitle: Building rule lookup for the BMC permission counter
app.mockBanner: Demo data: results come from test fixtures, not the rule service.

intake.heading: Plot details
intake.freeTextHint: Example: 200 sq m plot on a 9 m road. Front gap, floors and fee?
intake.parseFilled: Fields filled from the text are outlined. Check them, then press Look up.
intake.parseNothing: No plot details found in the text. Fill the form, or press Look up to search the Rules for this text.
intake.parsePartial: Some details could not be read from the text. Fill the outlined fields that are still empty.

fields.existing_developed_area: Is the plot in an existing developed area?
fields.narrowStreetHint: Streets under 6 m in existing developed areas use Rule 56(1)(b).

topics.heading: What to look up
topics.far: Floor area ratio and floor area
topics.plan_check: Plan check: draw the plot and check a footprint

footprint.heading: Proposed footprint
footprint.hint: Distance from each plot boundary to the building wall.

validation.summaryHeading: Fix these fields before looking up
validation.needTopic: Select at least one topic, or type a question to search the Rules.

result.heading: Result
result.emptyBody: Enter plot details and press Look up. Every result shows the rule number, the PDF page and the exact rule text.
result.derived: derived, not prescribed by the Rules
result.conditional: Depends on development type. Clerk selects.
result.hindiNote: The Hindi PDF page holds the official Hindi text. The rule text shown is the English source of truth.
result.liveRefused: Plan check not available for this case.

amendment.heading: Potentially relevant amendment
amendment.noticeTail: Not applied in these figures. Details below.

states.notFoundTitle: Not found in MP Bhumi Vikas Rules 2012
states.notFoundBody: The Rules do not cover this question. No rule number or figure is shown.
states.blockedTitle: Plan check stopped: plot area and dimensions do not match
states.refusedTitle: Plan check not available for this case
states.errorNetwork: The rule service could not be reached.
states.errorSchema: The rule service sent a response in an unexpected format.
states.errorHttp: The rule service returned an error.
states.disclaimer: This is a rule reference, not legal advice. The building-permission clerk decides.

plan.heading: Plan check
plan.drawingSummary: Plot {w} m by {d} m. Buildable envelope {ew} m by {ed} m. Proposed footprint {fw} m by {fd} m. {result}.
plan.tableCaption: Open space required and provided on each side
plan.exceptionsHint: Marking an exception adds a note. The conflict stays visible.
plan.sideChanged: {side} open space changed from {old} m to {new} m because the height changed.
